components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-button { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:6px; height:40px; padding:0 10px; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:var(--radius, 10px); background:var(--primary, #294fd1); background-clip:padding-box; color:var(--primary-foreground, #fdfdff); font:500 14px/20px var(--font-sans, "Instrument Sans", Arial, sans-serif); white-space:nowrap; cursor:pointer; transition:all 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-button:hover { background:color-mix(in oklab, var(--primary, #294fd1) 90%, transparent); } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline:0; border-color:var(--ring, #2f5ad9); box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring, #2f5ad9) 50%, transparent); } .ds-button:active { transform:translateY(1px); } .ds-button:disabled { opacity:.5; pointer-events:none; }

components.name: Outline Button

components.css: .ds-filters { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:8px; } .ds-filters a { display:inline-flex; padding:6px 12px; border:1px solid var(--border, #dce2ed); border-radius:var(--radius, 10px); background:var(--card, #fefeff); color:var(--foreground, #161f33); font:500 14px/20px var(--font-sans, "Instrument Sans", Arial, sans-serif); text-decoration:none; } .ds-filters a:hover { background:var(--muted, #eef1f7); } .ds-filters a[aria-current] { border-color:color-mix(in oklab, var(--primary, #294fd1) 25%, transparent); background:var(--accent, #e9efff); color:var(--primary, #294fd1); } .ds-filters a:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--ring, #2f5ad9); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Card
components.description: A thin edge frames content on the shared raised surface.

Saved prospects

Track product opportunities and plan your next follow-up.

components.name: Public Navigation
components.description: The current route stays visible as a blue tint.

components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; align-items:center; gap:4px; } .ds-nav a { padding:8px 12px; border-radius:calc(var(--radius, 10px) - 2px); color:var(--muted-foreground, #4c5a73); font:500 14px/20px var(--font-sans, "Instrument Sans", Arial, sans-serif); text-decoration:none; transition:color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-nav a:hover { background:var(--muted, #eef1f7); color:var(--foreground, #161f33); } .ds-nav a[aria-current=page] { background:var(--accent, #e9efff); color:var(--accent-foreground, #233f97); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--ring, #2f5ad9); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Directory Search
components.description: A single frame joins the field and its primary action.
components.html: <form class="ds-search" action="/directory"><svg aria-hidden="true" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="m21 21-4.34-4.34"/><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8"/></svg><input type="search" name="q" aria-label="Search the Davao directory" placeholder="Business or barangay"><button type="submit">Search</button></form>
components.css: .ds-search { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; width:min(100%, 448px); min-width:0; padding:6px; border:1px solid var(--input, #7485a1); border-radius:var(--radius, 10px); background:var(--card, #fefeff); box-shadow:0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); box-sizing:border-box; } .ds-search:focus-within { box-shadow:0 0 0 2px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring, #2f5ad9) 40%, transparent), 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); } .ds-search svg { flex:none; margin-left:8px; color:var(--muted-foreground, #4c5a73); } .ds-search input { flex:1 1 0; min-width:0; height:40px; border:0; outline:0; background:transparent; padding:0 4px; color:var(--foreground, #161f33); font:400 14px/20px var(--font-sans, "Instrument Sans", Arial, sans-serif); } .ds-search input::placeholder { color:var(--muted-foreground, #4c5a73); } .ds-search button { height:40px; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:var(--radius, 10px); background:var(--primary, #294fd1); color:var(--primary-foreground, #fdfdff); padding:0 16px; font:500 14px/20px var(--font-sans, "Instrument Sans", Arial, sans-serif); cursor:pointer; transition:all 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-search button:hover { background:color-mix(in oklab, var(--primary, #294fd1) 90%, transparent); } .ds-search button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--ring, #2f5ad9); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-search button:active { transform:translateY(1px); }

components.name: Form Feedback
components.description: An inline status or error beside a merchant form action.
components.css: .ds-feedback { margin:0; border:1px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--primary, #294fd1) 25%, transparent); border-radius:var(--radius, 10px); background:var(--accent, #e9efff); color:var(--accent-foreground, #233f97); padding:12px; font:400 14px/20px var(--font-sans, "Instrument Sans", Arial, sans-serif); } .ds-feedback[role=alert] { border-color:color-mix(in oklab, var(--destructive, #a82a31) 30%, transparent); background:color-mix(in oklab, var(--destructive, #a82a31) 8%, transparent); color:var(--destructive, #a82a31); }

narrative.overview:
The public site uses locally relevant imagery and plain labels to make the directory feel familiar. Search and map controls stay close to the places they describe. Photography shows everyday settings, and the homepage identifies its street scene as illustrative.

The merchant and studio workspaces carry the same cool surfaces, type, and cobalt actions into denser navigation, forms, and records. Dividers and consistent alignment let users scan lists and find their next action.
keyCharacteristics: Davao street scenes and category photography on public surfaces.
Cool neutrals, cobalt actions, and pale blue selection states.
Shared shadcn components with a compact workspace layout.

rules.name: The Primary Accent Rule
rules.body: Use cobalt for primary actions, links, and selection cues. Use the neutral palette for surrounding surfaces and secondary controls.

rules.name: The Surface Boundaries Rule
rules.body: Group content with surface colors, thin edges, and dividers. Use soft shadows where a control sits against the page or map.

dos: Do use the shared semantic colors so surfaces, controls, and focus respond to Light, Dark, and System.
Do use locally relevant public imagery and label illustrative scenes when the distinction matters.
Do use the shadcn Radix primitives and Tailwind utilities for shared control and layout patterns.
Do pair color changes with meaningful labels and keyboard focus for interactive states.
